newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Pique sees no rebound in long rates.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Pique sees no rebound in long rates.

text.p: Industry Minister Josep Pique ruled out on Thursday a rebound in long-term interest rates if fiscal policy remains restrictive and monetary policy orthodox.
"If we continue to control the public deficit and it continues to decline, there is no reason for interest rates to rise -- none," Pique told Spanish National Television.
The yield of the benchmark 10-year Spanish bond was hovering at 7.27 percent on Thursday morning.
